rights_summary: No third-party photographs, map tiles, logos, or case-study images are embedded. The only third-party display asset is a reduced Noto Sans SC subset embedded in local CSS solely to guarantee offline Chinese rendering; it is redistributed under SIL Open Font License 1.1 with its copyright notice, full licence, source hash, derivative hash, and CSS hash recorded below. No remote font is loaded. Official and institutional materials are cited as factual references only. Proposal text, diagrams, design geometry, offline visual assets, and three explicitly synthetic concept images are agent-generated for this submission. The local interface image used text only; the overall aerial and three-key-area triptych used only project-generated submission assets as references. None is factual site evidence. The account holder has explicitly authorised public release of outputs generated through the enterprise commercial account for this open call; source rights remain with their publishers and applicable service terms continue to apply.
